description: From medieval moral interludes to postmodern productions, the stage has long been a site for ethical inquiry. In this course, students study a set of ethical theories and apply them to their analyses of ethical problems and moral agency in four to five plays. The plays, which represent a range of genres and periods, are assigned viewing as well as reading; in addition to watching filmed productions, students will attend at least one live performance. Offered periodically. Prerequisites: ENGL 185 plus at least two English courses at level II.
